attributes.storage_instructions: Store the Cartiquin Tablet below 25°C in a clean and dry place, protected from direct sunlight, moisture and heat., Keep it away from children and pets., Do not use expired or damaged medicines., Dispose of unused medicine properly. Avoid flushing it in the toilet or throwing it into the drain.
